summary: The PR only patches `Query.__lt__` to skip `None`, but the issue explicitly states `>`, `<=`, and `>=` (and mixed str/num) crash the same way. Those three operators still raise TypeError on `None`, so the fix is incomplete. All 230 existing tests pass and the new `<` test passes, but the remaining operators need the same `value is not None and` guard.
